title: Semiconductor Leader AMD Continues to Trend Higher
text:
Semiconductor Leader AMD Continues to Trend Higher By 0
The dip buyers jumped in and quickly bought opening weakness this morning. This sort of buying has occurred so often and so automatically you have to wonder when it will end but for now it seems to be a self-fulling prophecy and feeds on itself once it begins.
The S&P 500 is now trading flat on the day after being down substantially in the premarket. Breadth is lagging with about 2500 gainers to 4000 decliners which tells us that this is index driven action more than individual stock buying action.
